design_notes: London to Edinburgh is air travel within mainland Great Britain, which 'is not permitted unless approval by exception is granted by a director' (lines 180-181). The director refused, so no flight is bought, whatever the fare; rail is the preferred means (lines 182-184). The manager's approval of air travel does not replace the director's exception.
